categories.note: Full silhouettes in profile, facing one way, standing on one ground line at one scale, as mascotas' dog-side and cat are: the big cats share one body, the bears one, the bovines one, the horses one (zebra, donkey, unicorn build on horse). The faces are front-on heads built like emociones' faces, ears and the one telling feature (mane, stripes, patches) at least 8 wide. The prints build on mascotas' paw pads. mascotas' rabbit, dog, and cat and juegos' teddy-bear exist: never draw them again. No cartoon characters or brand mascots.

The birds share one songbird body (bird) wherever the kind allows, in profile on one perch or ground line; bird-* builds on bird. Insects seen from the top share one axis and six legs, in profile one ground line. The dinosaurs are profiles on one ground line at one scale. comida's egg, agricultura's beehive, and desarrollo's bug exist: egg-hatching builds on the egg, and no insect may read as the bug. map-pin-bird builds on lugares' map pin as mascotas' map-pin-paw does.

It adopts fish (lugares): it exists, never draw it again; fish-* builds on fish. The fish kinds are profiles facing one way at one scale; the whales, dolphins, and orca share one fluke; the sharks one body; the shells one hinge; wave lines are lugares' wave. Animals seen from above (rays, crabs, starfish) stay centered on the canvas.

It adopts leaf, tree, tree-pine, palm-tree, flower, sprout, and cactus (lugares): they exist, never draw them again; tree-* builds on tree, leaf-* on leaf, the flowers on flower's stem, the potted plants on one pot (potted-plant is the family's base). The garden tools are drawn whole, never held by a pistol grip (DESIGN.md › 'A pistol grip, a material, a process'); herramientas' shovel exists. The robot mower builds on one body.

It adopts the weather of lugares (sun, sun-dim, moon, moon-stars, cloud, clouds, cloud-sun, cloud-moon, cloud-rain, cloud-drizzle, cloud-snow, cloud-hail, storm, fog, wind, tornado, snowflake, rainbow, thermometer, thermometer-up, thermometer-down, umbrella, droplet, droplets, sunrise, sunset): they exist, never draw them again. Every cloud-* builds exactly on cloud, cloud-sun, or cloud-moon, and the precipitation marks (drops, drizzle dashes, flakes, hail dots, bolts) are one set shared by the whole family; thermometer-* builds on thermometer, umbrella-* on umbrella, calendar-* on nucleo's calendar, map-pin-* on lugares' map pin. The fronts are a weather map's symbols, drawn as strokes.

It adopts recycle (lugares): it exists, never draw it again; *-recycle builds on its looping arrow. The bin-* share one sorting bin, the object dropping into its mouth at least 8 wide (DESIGN.md › 'A tiny pictogram inside a container'); the *-leaf icons put lugares' leaf where the engine's badge would sit; the *-emissions build on vehiculos' car-side and aviacion's plane; earth is a planet with landmasses, never nucleo's globe. A material, a process, or a diagram drawn alone reads as something else: say it by what it does to a place.
